content.summary: The matching six-page PDF has now been rendered and all six pages visually inspected. Mathematical displays, theorem labels, root table and references are readable without observed clipping or missing glyphs. The four spacing defects are repaired. HTML source preserves the six formulas and all eight external-link occurrences, but browser visual QA could not run because the browser executable and in-app browser were unavailable. Source attribution is explicit and locators survive conversion.

findings.statement: HTML source fidelity is checked, but HTML visual layout has not been observed in a browser. The CSS does not explicitly allow long inline code in the declaration table to wrap, so narrow-screen overflow remains an untested risk.
findings.disposition: Inspect the frozen HTML in an available browser or add tested wrapping before claiming complete HTML visual QA. Playwright launch failed because its Chromium executable was absent; the in-app browser was also unavailable.

findings.statement: PDF page 4 ends with the Section 5 heading and introductory sentence; the table starts on page 5. Two long Lean roots wrap within identifier words (including "eighty"). The complete text remains visible, but joining the section lead to the table and choosing punctuation/underscore break opportunities would improve source lookup.
findings.disposition: Optional layout polish; no result or identifier is omitted in the inspected PDF.

revisions.action: Checked the current frozen source and corresponding PDF prose for all four joined tokens.
revisions.result: All four are repaired to "by 9", "by 5", "plus 2" and "is 66".

revisions.action: Rendered the exact frozen PDF with pdftoppm and inspected pages 1–6; checked HTML source and source-to-display mappings.
revisions.result: PDF visual inspection is complete for this hash. HTML browser inspection remains unavailable and is carried explicitly as T2-html-visual-coverage.

checks.method: Recomputed every hash in preview-d786-v1/manifest.json and compared its manuscript bytes with round-02.
checks.observation: All four artifact entries match their manifest hashes, and the preview manuscript SHA-256 equals d786448baf9b526f72001e0e8ddbb582409cc728264a2074b44afde550ea6dc6.

checks.method: Rendered all six exact PDF pages with pdftoppm at 1500-pixel maximum dimension and visually inspected all page images. Compared the six displayed formulas against the frozen Markdown and the recorded explicit mappings.
checks.observation: All six formulas preserve inequality directions, coefficients, set-cardinality bars, subscripts and the summation index. No clipped equations, missing glyph boxes or table text loss were observed. The table is readable with two awkward but complete identifier wraps; ordinary inline subscript notation remains literal underscore source notation. Page numbering and references are visible.

checks.scope: Source map and citation locator conversion
checks.method: Compared the frozen primary-source ledger with the manuscript source labels; extracted HTML href values and PDF URI annotations. Inspected MathML and TeX annotations for all six displays.
checks.observation: All eight source-link occurrences survive in HTML and PDF, including the version-pinned Section 6.3 and Section 8 arXiv anchors. The public A1K report/repository labels remain distinct from the pinned source commit. Six MathML blocks retain the exact displayed TeX source. This is conversion and local-ledger checking, not fresh external source retrieval or authentication.

checks.method: Attempted a local Playwright render of the frozen HTML and attempted to open that exact file in the in-app browser.
checks.observation: Playwright lacked its Chromium executable, and the in-app browser reported unavailable. No HTML browser screenshot was obtained; responsive layout remains unverified.
